knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Ten per cent of 40 is 4, so the bid loses 4 points and scores 36.
In the example scale, medium is 50 per cent, good is 80 per cent and excellent is 100 per cent.
A quality-based specification sets the quality outcome and leaves the supplier to decide how to reach it, possibly with minimum frequencies.

practicalCriteria: Learner scores three sample prices against a 40-point price allocation with the lowest bid receiving 40 and the others scored correctly
Learner states, for a sample tender, whether the specification is activity-based versus quality-based, with the correct type given
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed scoring worksheet signed by the assessor
stopWorkCriteria: Tender criteria or weights were set after bids were opened
An abnormally low bid is accepted without written clarification
